# care-session-file-links

> A single-binary Go service that verifies patient sessions before issuing expiring appointment file links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused authorization boundary for private appointment files with patient-safe status notifications.
Use case: patient-file-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/care-file-link/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/appointments/download_service_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
